summary.text: Willy Keppel is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 38, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 primary.
He also appeared on the 2024 general election ballot for the same seat and was eliminated in the second round of ranked-choice counting.
